description: This file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to retrieve the action summary for an employee's dashboard in the HR management system. It uses various traits and services to gather data related to leave requests, timesheets, appraisals, self-reviews, and recruitment interviews, depending on enabled modules, and assembles this information into a structured JSON response.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class providing employee dashboard action summaries, utilizing traits for authentication, role management, and module services; it assembles data from different modules based on configuration and returns a structured summary.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the action summary for the authenticated employee, checking module enablement statuses and assembling respective pending actions into a JSON response.
